name: HTTPie Open Source CLI
free_limit: BSD-3-Clause open-source command-line HTTP client for sending API requests, testing endpoints, working with JSON, sessions, authentication and downloads on your own machine, with no vendor-imposed request quota in the CLI.
watch_out: This is a local command-line client, not a hosted API testing service. Your network, target API and infrastructure may have independent rate limits or costs. HTTPie desktop, web and cloud collaboration products have separate terms.
